purpose: Targeted coverage-first A/B for order 74 after replacing the model-facing zero-based deduplication key with a natural one-based column number.
change_scope: Expose document.deduplicate_records with a one-based key_column_number matching natural column ordinals, while retaining the old zero-based key_column only as an unexposed compatibility input inside the Writer Adapter. Add fail-closed audit evidence that model tool names and arguments reach the Adapter without Runner rewriting or injection. Leave the generic operation, model, Prompt, VM, evaluator, and all other tools unchanged.

implementation_evidence.hypothesis: In v35 Qwen selected document.deduplicate_records and correctly identified train_id as the second field, but supplied 2 to a zero-based key_column parameter and therefore deduplicated the third field. A reusable one-based key_column_number contract should align the API with the model's natural representation without Runner correction or task-specific state.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: Writer tests use pipe-delimited customer records keyed by natural column 1 and semicolon-delimited device records keyed by natural column 3, with different duplicate values and record structures. Runtime tests prove the exact one-based arguments selected by the model-facing call reach the Adapter executor unchanged. A separate compatibility test covers the unexposed legacy zero-based input.
implementation_evidence.current_instruction_router_check: document.deduplicate_records is third in the seven-action candidate list after document.inspect and document.save; its schema requires delimiter and one-based key_column_number and rejects additional properties.
implementation_evidence.prior_v35_outcome: Original evaluator 0.0 after four model turns. Qwen selected document.deduplicate_records and passed delimiter comma plus key_column 2 unchanged through the Runner. Because the contract was explicitly zero-based, the Adapter deduplicated station_id in the third field and left duplicate train_id values.
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes
implementation_evidence.changed_source_leakage_scan: No current task UUID, source episode ID, task filename, train values, golden value, or evaluator expected state appears in changed runtime or test sources.
